visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot showing a thick Spanish potato omelette being sliced with a knife, revealing the layered interior of potato, egg, and minced meat. The background is a bright, neutral kitchen setting. (2) A male chef in a black shirt holds a bowl of sliced potatoes, showing one slice to the camera to demonstrate its approximately 1cm thickness. (3) The chef cooks minced beef in a black frying pan, stirring with a red and black spatula; he then adds diced onions and garlic into the pan. (4) Close-up of seasonings being added: black pepper, salt, and tomato sauce are poured into the meat mixture and stirred thoroughly. (5) In a glass bowl, the chef whisks four eggs and adds salt, pepper, and cream, showing the smooth yellow liquid. (6) Butter melts in the pan before the chef pours in half the egg mixture, followed by a layer of potatoes and the cooked meat mixture. (7) More potatoes and cheese powder are added on top of the meat, followed by the remaining egg mixture, and then the pan is covered with a glass lid. (8) The chef, wearing red oven mitts, skillfully flips the entire omelette in the air using the pan in a slow-motion sequence. (9) The final product is shown again in a close-up, golden brown and sliced, with a call-to-action text appearing at the bottom.
